result.summary: Found 1 minor layout issue: the last restaurant card title in the Fastest near you row is clipped mid-word.

issues.description: In the Fastest near you carousel, the rightmost card’s restaurant name is cut off mid-word (“Trattoria Piccol”), so the full name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a shorter display name, or add enough padding/ellipsis so the name remains fully readable.
